"""Independent stdlib verifier for the exact registered JVA diagnostic artifact bytes."""
import gzip, hashlib, json, re, sys, zipfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(sys.argv[1]); REPO=Path(sys.argv[2]); E=json.loads((ROOT/'expected.json').read_text())
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
canonical=lambda o:json.dumps(o,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False).encode()

def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:raise ValueError(message)

def sealed(raw):
    o=json.loads(raw);require(isinstance(o,dict) and o.get('content_sha256')==sha(canonical({k:v for k,v in o.items() if k!='content_sha256'})),'internal JSON digest mismatch')
    return o

summaries={}; archives={}
for label in ('consumption','result'):
    path=ROOT/(label+'.zip');meta=E['artifacts'][label];wire=path.read_bytes()
    require(len(wire)==meta['size_in_bytes'] and sha(wire)==meta['digest'].removeprefix('sha256:'),'GitHub ZIP size or digest mismatch')
    require(meta['workflow_run']['id']==E['run_id'] and meta['workflow_run']['head_sha']==E['execution_commit_sha'],'artifact belongs to different execution')
    members={};hashes={}
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
        names=z.namelist();require(len(names)==len(set(names)),'duplicate archive member')
        for info in z.infolist():
            name=info.filename
            require(not info.is_dir() and not name.startswith('/') and '..' not in Path(name).parts and '\\' not in name and ((info.external_attr>>16)&0o170000)!=0o120000,'unsafe archive member')
            b=z.read(name);require(len(b)==info.file_size,'archive member size mismatch');members[name]=b;hashes[name]={'bytes':len(b),'sha256':sha(b)}
            if name.endswith('.json') and name not in {'code_ci_run_id.json','code_validation_run_id.json','parent-failure-run.json','parent-failure-artifact.json','immutable-parent-refs.json','consumption-ref.json'}:sealed(b)
    archives[label]=members;summaries[label]={'artifact_id':meta['id'],'zip_sha256':sha(wire),'zip_bytes':len(wire),'file_count':len(members),'files':hashes}

c=archives['consumption'];r=archives['result']
expected_c={'pip-freeze.txt','code_ci_run_id.json','code_validation_run_id.json','parent-failure-run.json','parent-failure-artifact.json','parent-failure.zip','immutable-parent-refs.json','consumption-ref.json','consumption.json','environment.json','contract.json','execution.json','requirements-sealed-execution-quote-v01.txt'}
require(set(c)==expected_c,'consumption inventory differs')
require(sha(c['parent-failure.zip'])==E['parent_failure_zip_sha256'],'parent failure ZIP changed')
require(c['contract.json']==r['contract.json']==(REPO/E['contract_path']).read_bytes(),'contract file changed')
require(c['execution.json']==r['execution.json']==(REPO/E['execution_path']).read_bytes(),'execution file changed')
require(c['consumption.json']==r['consumption.json'],'consumption differs between artifacts')
require(c['environment.json']==r['environment.json'],'environment differs between artifacts')
ex=sealed(c['execution.json']);con=sealed(c['consumption.json']);env=sealed(c['environment.json'])
require(ex['code_commit_sha']==E['code_commit_sha'] and ex['code_tree_sha']==E['code_tree_sha'],'execution code parent differs')
require(ex['workflow_file_sha256']==sha((REPO/E['workflow_path']).read_bytes())==E['workflow_sha256'],'workflow SHA differs')
require(con['workflow_run_id']==str(E['run_id']) and con['workflow_run_attempt']==1 and con['execution_commit_sha']==E['execution_commit_sha'],'consumption provenance differs')
require(con['execution_content_sha256']==ex['content_sha256'] and con['request_content_sha256']==E['request_sha256'],'consumption content binding differs')
ref=json.loads(c['consumption-ref.json']);require(ref['ref']==E['consumption_ref'] and ref['object']['sha']==E['execution_commit_sha'],'durable consumption ref differs')
for field,path in [('code_ci_run_id','.github/workflows/ci.yml'),('code_validation_run_id',E['workflow_path'])]:
    v=json.loads(c[field+'.json'])
    require(all(v.get(k)==x for k,x in {'id':int(ex[field]),'head_sha':E['code_commit_sha'],'head_branch':'phase-3-historical-snapshot','event':'push','run_attempt':1,'status':'completed','conclusion':'success','path':path}.items()),'exact code validation record differs')
parent=json.loads(c['parent-failure-run.json']);require(parent['id']==34076412463 and parent['run_attempt']==1 and parent['head_sha']=='e2c250367895d209ec4706288a22655636298685' and parent['conclusion']=='failure','parent failure execution changed')
parent_meta=json.loads(c['parent-failure-artifact.json']);require(parent_meta['id']==10002303908 and parent_meta['digest']=='sha256:'+E['parent_failure_zip_sha256'],'parent artifact metadata differs')
refs=json.loads(c['immutable-parent-refs.json']);require(set(refs)==set(E['immutable_refs']),'protected ref inventory differs')
for ref,expected in E['immutable_refs'].items():require(refs[ref]['ref']=='refs/'+ref and refs[ref]['object']['sha']==expected,'immutable ref changed')
lock=c['requirements-sealed-execution-quote-v01.txt'];require(sha(lock)=='03f4da335027e4c83bcf38e523c2e11aeaae49778f5bd6caa47e4703348b31b4','requirements lock differs')
pins=dict(re.findall(rb'^([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)==([^\s\\]+)',lock,re.M));pins={k.decode():v.decode() for k,v in pins.items()}
require(len(pins)==29 and env['implementation']=='CPython' and env['python_version']=='3.12.14' and env['package_versions']==pins,'exact hosted environment differs')
norm=lambda k:re.sub('[-_.]+','-',k).lower()
freeze=dict(re.findall(r'^([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)==([^\s]+)',c['pip-freeze.txt'].decode(),re.M))
require({norm(k):v for k,v in freeze.items()}=={norm(k):v for k,v in pins.items()},'pip freeze differs from pinned environment')
report=sealed(r['diagnostic-report.json']);inv=sealed(r['diagnostic-inventory.json']);receipt=sealed(r['diagnostic-receipt.json'])
require(inv['files']=={k:v for k,v in summaries['result']['files'].items() if k!='diagnostic-inventory.json'},'complete diagnostic file inventory differs')
for k in ('runtime_input_eligible','acquisition_gate_passed','account_or_fill_simulation_executed','backtesting_executed','retrospective_inputs_loaded','policy_changed','consumed_parent_rerun','raw_dbn_retained'):require(report[k] is False,'unexpected eligibility or activity')
require(report['diagnostic_evidence_complete'] is True and report['error'] is None and report['raw_temp_directory_removed'] is True,'diagnostic incomplete')
require(report['provenance']['execution_commit_sha']==E['execution_commit_sha'] and report['provenance']['workflow_run_id']==str(E['run_id']),'diagnostic report wrong run')
request=sealed(r['request.json'])['request'];require(sha(canonical(request))==E['request_sha256'],'exact request changed')
require(request=={'dataset':'XNAS.ITCH','schema':'mbp-1','symbols':['JVA'],'stype_in':'raw_symbol','trading_date':'2025-06-13','request_id':'2025-06-13-JVA-mbp-1','start_ns':1749822929742083339,'end_ns':1749822930392083340,'end_exclusive':True},'JVA request differs')
projections={}
for label,name in [('native_projection','native-projection.jsonl.gz'),('projection','diagnostic-projection.jsonl.gz')]:
    raw=gzip.decompress(r[name]);require(len(raw)<=64000000,'decompressed projection exceeds bound');lines=raw.splitlines(keepends=True);rows=[]
    for i,line in enumerate(lines):
        o=json.loads(line);require(canonical(o)+b'\n'==line and o['index']==i,'projection canonical order differs');rows.append(o)
    stats={'row_count':len(rows),'uncompressed_bytes':len(raw),'uncompressed_sha256':sha(raw),'file_bytes':len(r[name]),'file_sha256':sha(r[name]),'runtime_input_eligible':False}
    require(report[label]==receipt[label]==stats,'projection file/content hash differs');projections[label]=rows
n=sealed(r['native-observation.json']);m=sealed(r['normalization-observation.json']);ledger=sealed(r['http-ledger.json'])
require(report['native_observation']==n and report['observation']==m,'report observation binding differs')
require(n['wire_sha256']==report['ephemeral_dbn_sha256']==receipt['ephemeral_dbn_sha256'],'raw DBN hash binding differs')
require(report['same_dbn_bytes_as_failed_parent']==(n['wire_sha256']=='ae2ff3b0dd1be78d948ac39bda9de49eafef668e1678f92128aff6f1b227519f'),'prior DBN equality claim differs')
require(ledger['http_attempts']==3 and ledger['blocked_attempts']==0 and len(ledger['attempts'])==3,'separate diagnostic ledger differs')
for k in ('automatic_retries','redirects_followed','unregistered_endpoint_calls'):require(ledger[k]==0,'unexpected provider activity')
for i,method in enumerate(('metadata.get_billable_size','metadata.get_cost','timeseries.get_range')):
    row=ledger['attempts'][i];require(row['ordinal']==i+1 and row['method']==method and row['request_content_sha256']==E['request_sha256'] and row['http_status']==200 and row['status']==('success' if i<2 else 'complete'),'exact HTTP attempt differs')
require(ledger['attempts'][2]['dbn_file_sha256']==n['wire_sha256'] and ledger['attempts'][2]['wire_bytes']==n['wire_bytes'],'wire hash or byte count differs')
require(n['native_mbp1_count']==len(projections['native_projection']) and n['native_record_count']==sum(n['record_types'].values()),'native counts inconsistent')
require(m['projection_row_count']==len(projections['projection']) and m['frame']['row_count']==len(projections['projection']),'mapped counts inconsistent')
require(n['projection_content_sha256']==sha(canonical(projections['native_projection'])) and m['projection_content_sha256']==sha(canonical(projections['projection'])),'projection list commitment differs')
if n['native_record_count']==0:
    require(n['decoded_v3_record_bytes_sha256']==sha(b'') and not projections['native_projection'] and not projections['projection'],'metadata-only evidence has rows')
    require(m['normalization_code']=='empty_exact_request' and m['normalization_passed'] is False and m['normalizer_layer_row_count']==0,'empty v02 validator outcome differs')
    require(report['outcome']['code']=='metadata_only_exact_dbn_empty_before_mapping','empty diagnostic classification differs')
    for k,value in [('start',1749822929742083339),('end',1749822930392083340)]:require(n['metadata'][k]=={'kind':'integer','value':value},'native nanosecond bounds differ')
# Byte-identical inner failed acquisition is rechecked against its frozen full inventory.
a=sealed((REPO/E['parent_audit_path']).read_bytes())
with zipfile.ZipFile(io := __import__('io').BytesIO(c['parent-failure.zip'])) as z:
    expected=a['result_zip_verification']['files'];require(set(z.namelist())==set(expected) and len(z.namelist())==len(expected),'retained parent member inventory differs')
    for name,expected_file in expected.items():
        raw=z.read(name);require({'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':sha(raw)}==expected_file,'retained parent file changed')
result={'independent_verification_passed':True,'artifacts':summaries,'run_id':E['run_id'],'execution_commit_sha':E['execution_commit_sha'],
    'report_file_sha256':sha(r['diagnostic-report.json']),'report_content_sha256':report['content_sha256'],'inventory_content_sha256':inv['content_sha256'],
    'consumption_file_sha256':sha(c['consumption.json']),'consumption_content_sha256':con['content_sha256'],
    'native_record_count':n['native_record_count'],'native_mbp1_count':n['native_mbp1_count'],'mapped_row_count':m['frame']['row_count'],
    'wire_bytes':n['wire_bytes'],'raw_dbn_sha256':n['wire_sha256'],'same_dbn_bytes_as_failed_parent':report['same_dbn_bytes_as_failed_parent'],
    'outcome':report['outcome'],'parent_failure_files_verified':62,'immutable_refs_verified':7,'pinned_packages_verified':29,'http_attempts':3,'blocked_attempts':0,'acquisition_gate_passed':False}
result['content_sha256']=sha(canonical(result));(ROOT/'independent-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='artifacts'},indent=2,sort_keys=True))
